title: Zions Bank Foundation Donates $10,000 to Blood Cancer United
summary: Funds will support mission to help cure blood cancer and improve quality of life for blood cancer patients and their families.
body_markdown:
BOISE, Idaho; Aug. 10, 2026 — The Zions Bank Foundation has donated $10,000 to Blood Cancer United’s Boise Regional Office. Christina Miles, director of sales for Zions Bank and chair of Blood Cancer United’s executive committee for Light the Night, presented the check Aug. 10 to Ellie Saunders, campaign development manager at Blood Cancer United.


The funds will support Blood Cancer United’s mission to help cure blood cancer and improve the quality of life for blood cancer patients and their families. The organization hosts the annual Light the Night Walk, which honors those affected by blood cancer. Individuals or companies may sign up as a team to participate and raise funding to support lifesaving cancer research.


In addition to Miles’ involvement, Zions Bankers Ken Spencer and Jonathan Hobbs are serving as co-captains for Zions Bank’s team at this year’s Treasure Valley event, taking place Oct. 15 at Kleiner Memorial Park.


Supporting health and human services is a key focus of Zions Bank’s charitable giving.


“As someone with a loved one fighting blood cancer, I personally understand the impact that Blood Cancer United makes,” said Miles. “I’m proud to support their mission to cure blood cancer and give families more time and cherished memories together.”


**About the Zions Bank Foundation**


The Zions Bank Foundation is a tax-exempt charitable organization funded by Zions Bank, a division of Zions Bancorporation, N.A. Member FDIC, that operates exclusively for charitable purposes. Founded in 1873, Zions Bank has been serving the communities of the Intermountain West for more than 150 years. Additional information is available atwww.zionsbank.com .
